text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh… Pardon me. My attention lapsed for a moment there. Pay it no mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I apologize for making you worry and will endeavor to be more diligent in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's down to race exhaustion, but Mejiro Ardan is struggling to focus on training. I may need to rethink her schedule.
